mechanisms.description: Shared causal GRU maps byte embeddings and recurrent state to hidden trajectories.
Pooled router logits classify one of eight document-facet labels; router softmax weights low-rank output corrections during forward/generation.
Shared output head and mixture of facet-specific low-rank corrections predict next byte.
mechanisms.status: IMPLEMENTED; test NLL 1.8530 nats/byte on controlled corpus

mechanisms.description: Sustained zero ablations of single GRU hidden coordinates change next-byte NLL; coordinate semantics remain unknown.
